header.Purpose: Part of the source code for Luminary 1A build 099. It is part of the source code for the Lunar Module's (LM) Apollo Guidance Computer (AGC), for Apollo 11.
header.Mod history: 2009-05-23 HG	Transcribed from page images. 2009-06-05 RSB	Fixed a goofy thing that was apparently legal in GAP but not in yaYUL.  Eliminated a couple of lines of code that shouldn't have survived from Luminary 131 to here. 2009-06-07 RSB	Fixed a typo. This source code has been transcribed or otherwise adapted from digitized images of a hardcopy from the MIT Museum.  The digitization was performed by Paul Fjeld, and arranged for by Deborah Douglas of the Museum.  Many thanks to both.  The images (with suitable reduction in storage size and consequent reduction in image quality as well) are available online at www.ibiblio.org/apollo.  If for some reason you find that the images are illegible, contact me at info@sandroid.org about getting access to the (much) higher-quality images which Paul actually created. Notations on the hardcopy document read, in part: Assemble revision 001 of AGC program LMY99 by NASA 2021112-061 16:27 JULY 14, 1969

routines.name: NEWPHASE
routines.banner_comment: ROUTINES FOR STARTING NEW GUIDANCE PHASES:

instructions.label: GUIDSUB
instructions.raw: GUIDSUB		TS	NGUIDSUB	# ON SUCCEEDING PASSES SKIP TTFINCR

routines.name: LUNLAND

instructions.raw: OCT	00035		# GROUP 5:  RETAIN ONLY PIPA TASK
OCT	05023		# GROUP 3:  PROTECT GUIDANCE WITH PRIO 21
OCT	21000		#	JUST HIGHER THAN SERVICER'S PRIORITY

routines.banner_comment: NORMAL ENTRY:  CONTROL COMES HERE FROM SERVOUT

instructions.label: GUILDEN
instructions.raw: GUILDEN		EXTEND			# IS UN-AUTO-THROTTLE DISCRETE PRESENT?

instructions.label: P67NOW?
instructions.comment: NO:  ARE WE IN P67 NOW?
instructions.raw: P67NOW?		TC	CHECKMM		# NO:  ARE WE IN P67 NOW?
DCA	HDOTDISP	# SET DESIRED ALTITUDE RATE = CURRENT

instructions.comment: SHIFT SCALES DELTA TIME TO 2(17) CSECS
instructions.raw: SLR	PUSH		# SHIFT SCALES DELTA TIME TO 2(17) CSECS

instructions.label: CALCRGVG
instructions.comment: IN IGNALG, COMPUTE V FROM INTEGRATION
instructions.raw: CALCRGVG	TC	INTPRET		# IN IGNALG, COMPUTE V FROM INTEGRATION
VLOAD	MXV		#	OUTPUT AND TRIM CORRECTION TERM

instructions.comment: COMPUTED LAST PASS AND LEFT IN UNFC/2
instructions.raw: VATT1		#	COMPUTED LAST PASS AND LEFT IN UNFC/2

instructions.label: RGVGCALC
instructions.comment: ENTER HERE TO RECOMPUTE RG AND VG
instructions.raw: RGVGCALC	TC	INTPRET		# ENTER HERE TO RECOMPUTE RG AND VG
VAD	VSR2		# RESCALE TO UNITS OF 2(9) M/CS

instructions.comment: NO SHIFT SINCE ANGTERM IS DOUBLE SIZED
instructions.raw: CG		# NO SHIFT SINCE ANGTERM IS DOUBLE SIZED
STODL*	TABLTTF +6	# A(3) = 8 JDG  TO TABLTTF
AD	LEADTIME	# LEADTIME IS A NEGATIVE NUMBER
AD	POSMAX		# SAFEGUARD THE COMPUTATIONS THAT FOLLOW
TS	L		#	BY FORCING -TTF*LEADTIME > OR = ZERO

instructions.label: EXGSUB
instructions.raw: EXGSUB		TC	INTPRET		# COMPUTE TRIM VELOCITY CORRECTION TERM.
DXCH	MPAC +3		# PWR TABLE ADRES, N-1

instructions.comment: NO POWER SERIES DEGREE 1 OR LESS
instructions.raw: CCS	MPAC +4		# NO POWER SERIES DEGREE 1 OR LESS

instructions.comment: MODE USED AS ITERATION COUNTER.  MODE
instructions.raw: CA	ZERO		# MODE USED AS ITERATION COUNTER.  MODE

instructions.comment: MUST BE POS SO ABS WON'T COMP MPAC+3 ETC.
instructions.raw: TS	MODE		# MUST BE POS SO ABS WON'T COMP MPAC+3 ETC.

instructions.label: TABLTTFL
instructions.raw: TABLTTFL	ADRES	TABLTTF +3	# ADDRESS FOR REFERENCING TTF TABLE

instructions.label: PROJMAX
instructions.raw: PROJMAX		DEC	.42262 B-3	# SIN(25')/8 TO COMPARE WITH PROJ

instructions.label: PROJMIN
instructions.raw: PROJMIN		DEC	.25882 B-3	# SIN(15')/8 TO COMPARE WITH PROJ
